text.insert: An agent routes a visual with four checks, in order. The first check that matches decides the block.
Send steps, exchanges, rows, or fields to the matching typed block: process-outline, sequence, structured-table, or state-shape.
When the reader must match the picture to a physical object by port number, position, or scale, use an html replica.
When the reader must change an input and watch the result, use an html explorable.
Use canvas for any other question about how things relate.
Two tie-break tests settle the cases between canvas and html.
Redraw the figure as plain boxes and arrows. If the reader loses nothing, the figure belongs on canvas.
If every state fits on screen at once, show the states side by side instead of behind a toggle.

text.insert: Ship A first, then B, and hold C until a second corpus needs a shared model. A stops agents from choosing the wrong block. B removes the largest hand-styling cost, and C waits for evidence beyond network-setup.

A model sidecar is a hard-to-reverse format
A builder script plus a recorded source hash covers network-setup today. A sidecar format should wait until two corpora agree on its shape.
The shape has four parts: authoring rules, a host contract, a data approach, and lint rules. Every name in this section is proposed.
These rules come from the rack figures. Each one names the failure it prevents.

text.insert: Phase 3 unblocks the network-setup cleanup. That work rebuilds both rack figures from the current config and gives cables stable ids across current and target. It also moves the static topology figures to canvas.
Two choices become expensive once many blocks depend on them.
names. The names should match the token set the mockups spec adopts, so one set serves both.
Figures never fetch live data. Data reaches a figure only at build time or, in Phase 4, through a host message.
Each question has a recommended default, so Phase 1 can start before it is answered.
Does canvas also cover general concepts?
The canvas foundation doc limits canvas to software diagramming. Recommended default is yes for concepts such as VLAN basics, which means widening canvas guidance and adding a dark board.
Should the model sidecar ship before a second corpus asks?
Recommended default is no. Phase 3 hash checks cover drift at lower cost.
Do explorables need a stricter script policy?
Recommended default is no. The CSP already blocks network and parent access.
